purpose: Paper-facing scientific dataset protocol for deciding which downstream tasks are core, supporting, or deferred; which versions and splits must be frozen; and which validation and test molecules must be excluded from P1 and P2 training memberships. Broad source inventory remains in v1; the linked acquisition manifest records only the selected paper-source files needed to make these protocol decisions reproducible.

paper_scope.scope_boundary: Core and supporting tasks are the current paper protocol. Deferred tasks are named to prevent silent scope ambiguity but are not current evaluation or decontamination obligations.

decontamination_policy.multi_view_grouping: All property prompts, text prompts, and conformers for one canonical connectivity identity stay in the same split group.
decontamination_policy.reported_view_rule: Preserve official or legacy benchmark rows for reported-protocol comparison; build a separately named connectivity-clean view for leakage-controlled claims.
decontamination_policy.deferred_rule: PubChemQC and retrieval contribute no identities to the current protected union. Promotion requires a new registry version before the training run whose claims would use them.

changes_required: Replace the legacy row-level QM9 validation and test artifacts with a molecule-group-disjoint scientific split; retain the legacy artifacts only as diagnostics.
Freeze separate reported-protocol and connectivity-clean views for PubChem captioning and ChEBI-20 instead of rewriting an official split in place.

Treat the published MoleculeSTM 200-source-molecule list and FineMolTex twelve-prompt namespace as a sealed compatibility test. Build a separate canonical-connectivity-disjoint development membership from ZINC250K and justify its size rather than imposing an arbitrary threshold.

Retain MoleculeSTM revision ff2de71fa6bb0533d5e740db6d88a0442a0d38e8 as count-matched fallback evidence. For BACE, BBBP, and ClinTox, the legacy CSV plus three scaffold splits are internally valid KPGT-layout-compatible candidates but remain non-official until compared with Figshare file 35391163; the current region returns HTTP 403. KPGT excludes HIV, and the official 3D-MolT5 release inventory exposes no traceable HIV members or split. HIV therefore uses the SHA-256-bound DeepChem HIV.csv source with a frozen deterministic Murcko 8:1:1 derived-v1 split. Full P1 still waits for formal member manifests, canonical identities, and the protected union.
Move PubChemQC out of the current core path and keep retrieval deferred; neither blocks architecture canaries or enters the present protected union.
unchanged_principles: Downstream validation and test protection is defined at canonical connectivity rather than instruction-row level.
Downstream training overlap with pretraining may be retained and disclosed.
No global scaffold exclusion is applied to pretraining.
Task-specific metrics and independent ablations remain necessary; one aggregate downstream score is insufficient.

tasks.scientific_question: Does motif-level 3D encoding improve molecular orbital property prediction while keeping numeric generation stable, and is the gain attributable to geometry rather than duplicated prompts or split leakage?

source_basis.observed_artifacts: The frozen release has 347774 train rows, 1928 validation rows, and 1928 test rows; validation and test are byte-identical. Using train plus exactly one validation copy gives 349702 source rows. Removing 42 later model-visible exact duplicates leaves 349660 rows in 128836 strict canonical-isomeric molecule groups.
source_basis.reported_protocol: Retain the unmodified 3D-MolT5 row split only as a compatibility diagnostic; it is not a headline evaluation because validation and test are duplicated and identity leakage is severe.
source_basis.clean_protocol: Keep the frozen 3D-MolT5 E3FP, SELFIES, instruction, and target payloads; consume train plus validation and forbid the duplicate test file; remove only exact model-visible duplicates; regroup by strict canonical-isomeric molecular identity; route HOMO, LUMO, and gap in Hartree.

split_protocol.multi_view_grouping: All HOMO, LUMO, and gap prompts and all retained E3FP states sharing one strict canonical-isomeric molecular identity stay in one split.
split_protocol.split_identity_boundary: Strict canonical-isomeric molecular identity approximates the absent released molecule ID. Canonical non-isomeric connectivity is emitted separately and is used only for the more conservative P1/P2 protected union.
split_protocol.external_protocol_boundary: The 110000/10000/remainder scale follows common QM9 geometric-model practice; exact SchNet or DimeNet membership is not claimed because the 3D-MolT5 artifact lacks the original molecule-ID row map.

geometry_protocol.conformer_policy: Use the released 3D-MolT5 E3FP unchanged for the primary same-source comparison. Do not claim independent row-level coordinate provenance and do not mix regenerated conformers into this view.

metrics.selection_rule: Select checkpoints on validation MAE after numeric validity is acceptable; report per-property test values rather than a prompt-weighted aggregate alone.

next_actions: Run the frozen split builder over the remote train and validation Parquet files on the high-CPU instance; the released test file is forbidden.
Verify the expected 349660 rows, 128836 strict groups, 42 removed exact duplicates, 110000/10000/8836 group sizes, and 298529/27211/23920 row sizes.
Freeze explicit property routes, units, and numeric parser tests.
Use the emitted validation and test canonical non-isomeric connectivity identities when rebuilding the protected pretraining union.

source_basis.observed_artifacts: The registered MoleculeSTM file has 200 nonempty lines and 200 unique records. FineMolTex generation_Optimization.py:146 reads that file by default, and downstream_molecule_edit_utils.py:34-72 defines prompt IDs 101-106, 205-206, and 501-504.
source_basis.reported_protocol: Use the published 200-member MoleculeSTM list as the all-run-sealed FineMolTex compatibility test; it is never used for development or checkpoint selection.
source_basis.clean_protocol: Select and freeze a separate ZINC250K development membership that is canonical-connectivity-disjoint from the sealed 200-member test; justify its size without a preset minimum.

split_protocol.multi_view_grouping: All editing prompts for one source molecule stay in one development or test group. Development members are disjoint from the published sealed test; generated outputs are scored against the registered operation rather than treated as paired training targets.

geometry_protocol.conformer_policy: Freeze source conformers and record whether output geometry is generated, optimized, or evaluated only through structural validity.

metrics.selection_rule: This is zero-shot evaluation; no checkpoint is selected on the sealed test. Development may validate prompts and evaluators only.

next_actions: Select, justify, and freeze a ZINC250K development membership disjoint from the published sealed test, then derive its canonical identities for the full-P1 protected union.
Keep the published 200-member compatibility test sealed throughout model and evaluator development.

tasks.scientific_question: Does the learned motif-level representation transfer to BACE activity classification under a provenance-frozen benchmark split?

source_basis.observed_artifacts: The legacy candidate has 1513 CSV rows; each of its three split files gives complete, within-file pairwise-disjoint, duplicate-free Murcko scaffold 8:1:1 partitions of 1210/151/152. Chiral and achiral Murcko cross-partition overlap are zero, all SMILES are valid, and every partition has positive and negative labels, so AUROC is computable. These facts do not prove official KPGT equivalence.

source_basis.clean_protocol: After formal source comparison or authoritative replacement, freeze the exact source revision and validation/test membership before full P1 protection; freeze label join and 3D conformer recipe before downstream training.

split_protocol.multi_view_grouping: All labels and conformers for one molecule remain in one split.

geometry_protocol.conformer_policy: Freeze generator, protonation, stereochemistry, seed, conformer selection, and failure handling.

metrics.selection_rule: Select on validation ROC-AUC and report test ROC-AUC under the frozen split only.

next_actions: Verify whether provenance-complete 3D-MolT5 BACE data can be recovered; otherwise compare the candidate against KPGT Figshare file 35391163 from an accessible region.
